******************************
****Dummy variable************
******************************

clear

sysuse auto //open the dataset stored in the Stata system

*1)generate a binary dependent variable

mean(price) //calculate the mean of price, mean(price)=6165

gen expensive=1 if price>6165 

replace expensive=0 if price<6165 | price==6165 // "|" means "or","&" means "and"

*or

gen expensive=(price>6165) if price !=. 
//expensive=1,if the judgement in parentheses is true.
//"!="means "does not equal"

label variable expensive "=1 when price > 6165" 


*2)use "outreg2" to save your regression results

ssc install outreg2 // install the command

*estimate a linear probability model
reg expensive weight

outreg2 using reg_results.doc, replace ctitle(LPM)
// "reg_results" is the file name decided by the user

*estimate a probit model
probit expensive weight

outreg2 using reg_results.doc, append ctitle(Probit)

*estimate a logit model
logit expensive weight

outreg2 using reg_results.doc, append ctitle(Logit)


*3)estimate a model with an interaction

gen interaction=weight*length

reg expensive weight length interaction //should include every variable in the interaction

*or

reg expensive c.weight##c.length //double "##". A kind reminder: don't forget the "c." prefix.

reg expensive weight length c.weight#c.length //single "#"
